evals.name: process-scope-measurements-and-doors
evals.prompt:
Run me through a `/assess process` pass on /home/user/harness-ref (real repo; do not read anything under skills/ or agents/ there). I want to know exactly what the pass produces and where each kind of result goes — I don't need you to actually write the report, I need the procedure, grounded in this repo. Derive the measurements the pass owes if you can get them.

Save it as process-pass.md in the output directory.
evals.expected_output: A written artefact demonstrating assess judgment on a recorded failure mode.
expectations: The answer derives, or names the exact derivation for, all three standing measurements: gate duration, module count, and the guard-to-deliverable ratio
It states that a count of zero gate durations means this clone has run no gate since the field existed, not that the gate is instant
It routes deletion and simplification candidates to the improvement ledger, not to the ticket queue, and gives the reason
It says the small tail that contradicts the tree today — a check asserting something false, an unowned hole over a live risk — is filed
It says an unattended run does not drain the ledger, and why
It runs the repo's verify gate on the committed report before pushing

evals.name: architecture-scope-may-file-nothing
evals.prompt:
I ran `/assess architecture` on /home/user/harness-ref (real repo; do not read anything under skills/ or agents/ there) and the system shape looks broadly right. I found two things worth keeping, one boundary I'd watch, and no risk I'd call actionable.

Have I done it wrong? What do I file, and what does the report have to carry? Save your answer as arch-pass.md in the output directory.
evals.expected_output: A written artefact demonstrating assess judgment on a recorded failure mode.
expectations: The answer says filing zero tickets is a valid outcome for this scope, not a failed run
It says positive observations and stable trade-offs live in the report, not in the backlog
It says only actionable risks become tickets
It names what the report must carry: a verdict plus narrative — what is working, the risks, and a watchlist
It says the report is still recorded even with no findings, because it is evidence the assessment ran
It does not tell the user to invent findings to justify the run

evals.name: drain-the-ledger
evals.prompt:
End of a `/assess code` pass on /home/user/harness-ref (real repo; do not read anything under skills/ or agents/ there), run by me at the keyboard. The improvement ledger has 34 entries built up since the last drain. Several of them are clearly about the same file.

What do I do with them? Save your answer as drain.md in the output directory.
evals.expected_output: A written artefact demonstrating assess judgment on a recorded failure mode.
expectations: Entries are grouped by their suggested home, abstracted into pattern-level candidates where several are evidence of one thing, and prioritised — presented as a short slate rather than the raw list of 34
Every entry leaves the drain marked as exactly one of three outcomes: done, folded, or dropped
A folded entry becomes a ticket in Todo with exactly one assurance level, and its ticket id is recorded
A dropped entry has its reason written down
An entry not promoted at this drain is dropped rather than carried forward unmarked
The outcomes are recorded back on the ledger thread so the next drain does not re-present an answered entry
